title: Erasmus Bridge
materials: На странице проекта материалы не специфицированы; выразительность моста построена на асимметричном пилоне, системе вант и подъемном пролетном механизме bascule section.
summary_en: Erasmus Bridge is an asymmetric cable-stayed bridge with a backward-leaning 139-meter pylon, radiating cable arrays, and an integrated bascule section. The project turns structural geometry into a civic landmark known as The Swan.

title: Music Theatre (MUMUTH)
architects: UNStudio, Ben van Berkel, Caroline Bos
materials: Concrete structural twist, glass curtain wall facade with vertical metal framing, интегрированные потолочно-стеновые акустические панели и световые приборы в параметрической внутренней оболочке.
summary_en: MUMUTH is organized around a central spiraling concrete twist that acts as structure, circulation, and spatial organizer. The project negotiates between curvilinear internal geometry and a rectilinear outer envelope through a repeated parametric facade and acoustic panel system.
